subject: B71D6E7CFCC8E05A303BFE9F83981E31
introduction: People wrote to ‘Abdu’l-Bahá asking him to name a newborn, or to give them a new name themselves, and his answers nearly always turn the name into a prayer: “As Thou hast named him Beauty, make him beautiful.” A name, he says, is nothing without a bearer worthy of it. He also describes a simple ceremony for naming a child. Scripture is full of meaningful names and renamings: Simon called Peter, the “new name” on the white stone, Hannah’s Samuel, “I have called thee by thy name”. Juliet’s “what’s in a name?” is the common-sense objection.
questions: Does a name influence the person who bears it? How?
Why turn the giving of a name into a prayer?
What would it mean to live up to your own name?

outside.why: Zahrá means radiant. Juliet: what’s in a name? that which we call a rose by any other name would smell as sweet. The readings insist a name means something, and that its bearer must earn it. Who is right?
A name has no importance without a bearer worthy of it. A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches.
As Thou hast named him Beauty, make him beautiful. I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
Bahrám is a star that lights East and West. They that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament.
A heavenly title asked for. To him that overcometh will I give a white stone, and in the stone a new name written.
‘Abbás means lion; the name needs one who embodies it. Thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church: a fisherman renamed for what he was to become.
Children perpetuate one’s name only if they are worthy. Good name in man and woman is the immediate jewel of their souls.
How to name a child: gather friends, pray. Hannah at Samuel’s naming: for this child I prayed; therefore also I have lent him to the Lord.
This child whom Thou hast brought forth. Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord.
Gladden through him the eyes of his parents. Her children arise up, and call her blessed.

shortfall: Readings 7, 10, 13 and 14 and those after 15 repeat the pattern for other children.
